rows.notes_markdown: xboxrecomp-based native Windows and Linux port with a Vulkan renderer. Requires the retail USA release (title ID 5443000D) and Vulkan 1.3. Known issues include water rendering on Nvidia/Windows, Windows ISO installation failures and 21:9 edge pop-in. Windows has been tested under Proton and a Windows 11 VM; broader physical-PC reports are requested. Steam Deck first-run installation requires Desktop Mode.
Windows x64 static recompilation requiring a user-owned USA Xbox copy. Version 0.3.0 documents a playable release, while the game remains 4:3 and the optional HD texture pack is separate.
